legal.title: Terms & Disclaimer
legal.body:
WT Market is a third-party War Thunder account marketplace. We operate independently and are not affiliated with any game developer or publisher.

All accounts sold are third-party accounts with the following conditions: (1) Accounts are sold without email access. (2) Credentials provided: username/email + password for game login. (3) Stock is limited and first-come first-served. (4) Product descriptions reflect condition at time of listing.

As a buyer, you understand that third-party accounts carry inherent risks such as access restrictions, deactivation, or recovery by previous owners. WT Market cannot guarantee long-term account availability after purchase.

We provide a First Login Guarantee: if the provided credentials do not work on first login, we will replace them with a new account at no extra cost. Claims must be made within 24 hours with screenshot/video proof. Guarantee applies to first login only.

Payments are processed through Midtrans (QRIS, bank transfer, e-wallet, cards). No refunds after credentials are successfully delivered. Failed or duplicate payments are automatically refunded by Midtrans. All prices in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).

Buyer data is used solely for transaction purposes and is not shared with third parties.
